## Learning Objectives

- Perform and interpret contrasts and multiple pairwise comparisons, such as Tukey’s HSD and Bonferroni, to evaluate differences between treatment means.

:::


**Notes:**

- There is one slide deck to follow along with, but the links below go to the relevant starting point for each video.

- Dr. Robinson discusses how to do analysis in JMP, you can **skip these!** We will not use JMP in this class and you will notice I removed those slides.

- Take notes while you watch and summarize the main points for yourself!

- If you want more or a different modality, read Oehlert Ch 4-5.
